summary: Project DPS NebulaMission Architect is a browser game in which players design and fly a complete space mission, from concept to operations. Players build a spacecraft part by part in 3D, choose a rocket and ground antennas, launch, and then see whether their design survives realistic surprises in flight. Every choice uses up mass, power, budget or data capacity. The game turns abstract engineering trade-offs into things players can see and feel, and judges each mission by how much science reaches the scientists.
details:
• A complete mission: the game follows NASA’s four mission segments. In the space segment players pick the bus, instruments, power, communications and propulsion. In the launch segment they pick a vehicle that can lift the spacecraft. In the ground segment they choose antennas such as the Deep Space Network. The user segment shows how much science was delivered.
  • Real trade-offs: solar power falls off with distance from the Sun, and data rates fall off with distance from Earth. Fuel is sized with the rocket equation, and launch capacity depends on the destination. Live gauges and a margin radar show every consequence the moment a part is picked.
